The '''1897–98 Belgian First Division''' was a season of the [[Belgian First Division]], the top-level [[association football]] league in Belgium. In its third year of operation, the league was contested by five teams. [[R.F.C. de Liège|F.C. Liégeois]] won the championship.<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/belghist.html |title=Belgium – Final Tables 1895–2008 |publisher=The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation |last1=Ploquin |first1=Phil |last2=Nackaerts |first2=Luc |last3=Coolsaet |first3=Jeroen |access-date=16 December 2018}}</ref>
